content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high severity) — § 13.1 licence grant**

§ 13.1 grants the Services licence to "Customer alone," expressly "without Affiliates or contractors," non-transferable, and "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion." That fails the fallback on every material term and touches the walk-away position (revocable at Vendor's discretion with affiliates/contractors excluded and no path to add them).

The internal counterweights don't cure it: § 13.2's perpetual, irrevocable Affiliate/contractor licence is confined to paid-up software and embedded Deliverables, and § 13.3's notice-and-cure revocation limit and Affiliate/successor transfer right directly contradict § 13.1 rather than fixing the Services grant's scope.

Redline validated (ok:true) — smallest edit reaching the preferred position:

> 13.1 Vendor grants Customer ~~alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion,~~ **and its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf, a licence** to use the Services~~ without Affiliates or contractors.~~**, revocable or suspendable only as permitted by Section 13.3 and transferable to a successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24.**

Comment lodged: "[Playbook] We extended the Services licence to our Affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, and replaced revocation at Vendor's sole discretion with the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in Section 13.3... If helpful, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice as a fallback."
